newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian bourse rebounds, BUX futures stronger.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian bourse rebounds, BUX futures stronger.

text.p: The Hungarian share market closed a fraction higher on Friday, propelled by a stronger U.S. dollar which was giving some positive tone to the bourse ahead of the U.S. Fed's meeting next Tuesday, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 5,084.80 points, up 15.50. BUX futures firmed for all maturities by between 66.50 and 152.50 points. June BUX closed 95.00 points up at 5,362.50 points.
"Nerves have calmed down a bit, not everybody is as pessimistic as they were so far," said Gyorgy Czipo of ING Barings.

On Friday the market's leading gainers included OTP Bank which was said benefiting from a positive market sentiment rather than an upbeat newspaper report about the bank's 1996 performance. OTP closed at 3,410 forints, up 105.
Meanwhile meat processor Pick's shares were pushed higher by a lack of liquidity owned to weak supply.
"Pick's market is completely illiquid and a bigger order on either side can substantially move the market," one trader said. Pick closed at 11,300 forints, up 345.

Elsewhere on the market, chemicals Borsodchem edged up 60 forints to 6,050, after the company established Borsodchem Polska Kft, a Katowice-based unit, with the aim of boosting Borsodchem's share on the Polish market.

Brewery Soproni firmed 100 forints to finish at 5,600 in thin volume after it had proposed to pay higher dividends on both preference and ordinary stocks, while brewery Martfu, which plans an unchanged 15 percent dividend, put on 30 forints to 3,050.
